name: Blocks demo (sample)
author: Myspoti
description: A sample that adds one block of each kind: a Home section, a search result, a menu entry, a player button, a line under the credits and a small page.

actions.name: home.sections
actions.why: Shows a 'Played here' section at the end of Home

actions.name: search.provide
actions.why: Adds a hint under the search results

actions.name: menu.items
actions.why: Adds 'Count a play' to song menus

actions.name: player.buttons
actions.why: Adds a counter button under the player

actions.name: trackinfo.provide
actions.why: Shows how often you counted the song in its credits

actions.name: webview.page
actions.why: A small page listing what you counted

actions.name: storage
actions.why: Remembers the counts on this phone

actions.name: notify
actions.why: Says when a play was counted
